text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `network-lb-health` (severity: P1).
incident-bot: Alert: TLS handshake failure rate > 8% on eu-west-1 edge pool for the last 2m. Recent deploys: edge-proxy v2.13.4. Runbook: <https://runbooks.redwood.internal/lb-tls#mitigation>. Pager: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty: alex.kim@redwood on-call (primary) has been paged.

Alex Kim: taking this, jumping on the call. starting triage.

Maria Lopez: I can see a sharp spike in TLS_ALERT and `unsupported_protocol` in the dataplane logs across a subset of targets. Not global yet, mostly eu-west-1-a/b.

Tanvi Patel: same, got SNI mismatch-ish logs and lots of `SSL routines:tls_choose_sigalg:unsupported` in the proxy. correlation with last edge-proxy config rollout 00:09 UTC (CI 9f3b2e).

Alex Kim: noted. quick check: `kc get pods -n edge --selector=app=edge-proxy -o wide` shows new pods 9f3b2e and old pods still draining.

Maria Lopez: past 5m from our healthcheck:
```
[2026-03-14T00:12:32Z] target=10.2.3.5 TLS handshake fail 24/200
[2026-03-14T00:12:33Z] target=10.2.3.8 TLS handshake fail 18/190
[2026-03-14T00:12:34Z] target=10.2.3.12 TLS alert unsupported_cert
```

Ryan O'Neill: verifying client->edge cipher negotiation. looks like the new config removed some RSA ciphers that some customers still use. rolling a quick revert for the edge-proxy config to previous cipher list. will patch on one AZ first.

Tanvi Patel: agree canary rollback. I'll update routing to shift traffic off eu-west-1-a while we revert.

Alex Kim: executing revert now: `kubectl set env deploy/edge-proxy EDGE_CIPHERS=legacy-list-202602` then restart.

incident-bot: Deploy started: edge-proxy revert (deployment edge-proxy) by Alex Kim. CI: rollback-9f3b2e -> 9f3b2d.

pagerduty: Alex Kim acknowledged incident (ack id: PD12345-A).

Maria Lopez: after rollback on eu-west-1-a, TLS handshakes on those targets dropped failure rate to ~1.2% in 30s.

Ryan O'Neill: shifting weights off eu-west-1-b temporarily to reduce blast radius. Command: `rbctl set-weight eu-west-1-b 0.2`

Alex Kim: confirmed health improvements. still monitoring for any lingering 502s reported by customers.

Tanvi Patel: customer impact: two mid-market customers in EU reported transient 502s for ~90s. No data loss, requests retried by clients. Raising post-incident notif to them.

Maria Lopez: adding note to incident timeline and creating follow-up ticket: PROD-5492 (audit cipher policy & backward-compatibility tests).

Ryan O'Neill: I'll open an RCA doc and assign owners for gate in CI to prevent removing legacy ciphers without canarying.

Alex Kim: on-call handoff in 25m — if stable I'll run postmortem and hand to next on-call. If it regresses, ping me directly.

incident-bot: Incident state: acknowledged -> mitigated. Relevant runbook step completed: rollback config.

pagerduty: Incident resolved by Alex Kim. auto-close in 1h unless further activity.

Alex Kim: summary: rollback of edge-proxy cipher list resolved TLS handshake failures in eu-west-1. Impact limited to eu customers for ~2m, ~2 customers saw 502 spikes. Follow-ups: PROD-5492 (tests), OPS-120 (canary gating), schedule postmortem doc.

Tanvi Patel: adding retrospective item to SRE retro: improve synthetic TLS coverage for legacy ciphers.

Maria Lopez: leaving logs/snippets in the incident doc. closing my loop with affected PMs.

Alex Kim: closing thread, will publish postmortem doc in ~24h. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident closed (ID PD12345). Link to timeline: <https://incidents.redwood.internal/PD12345>
